en.headline: HSBC first-half profit before tax rises 23% to US$19.5 billion
en.dek: The bank reported higher banking net interest income and strong wealth fee growth, declared a second interim dividend of US$0.10 per share and plans a share buy-back of up to US$1 billion.
body: HSBC Holdings reported profit before tax of US$19.5 billion for the first half of 2026, up 23% from a year earlier. Reported revenue rose 11% to US$37.7 billion, driven by growth in banking net interest income and higher fee and other income, particularly in wealth management and wholesale transaction banking.

The bank said constant-currency profit before tax excluding notable items increased by US$1.1 billion to US$20.4 billion. Expected credit losses rose to US$2.35 billion, including provisions related to Hong Kong commercial real estate and ongoing uncertainty in the Middle East.

The board declared a second interim dividend of US$0.10 per ordinary share and said it intends to commence a share buy-back of up to US$1 billion, expected to be completed before the third-quarter results. Hong Kong remained a significant contributor, delivering constant-currency profit before tax of US$5.1 billion.

zh.headline: 滙控上半年稅前盈利升23%至195億美元
zh.dek: 銀行業務淨利息收益及財富管理費用收入增長帶動業績，派第二次中期股息每股10美仙，並計劃最多10億美元股份回購。
body: 滙豐控股公布，2026年上半年列賬基準稅前利潤195.2億美元，按年上升23%。收入377.4億美元，按年升近11%，受惠於銀行業務淨利息收益增加，以及國際財富管理及卓越理財業務與香港業務旗下財富管理客戶活動上升。
不計及須予注意項目的固定匯率稅前利潤增至204億美元。預期信貸損失及其他信貸減值準備變動為23.5億美元，按年升逾21%，當中包括與香港商業房地產相關的準備，以及反映中東局勢不確定性的提撥。
董事會宣布派發第二次中期股息每股10美仙，並有意啟動最多10億美元的股份回購計劃，預計於第三季業績公布前完成。香港業務以固定匯率計算的稅前利潤為51.4億美元。
